rewrite_prompts.text: Rewrite this line in plain, emotionally neutral wording, keeping only the literal information: "{ar}". Start with '{A}:'. Output only the rewritten line.
rewrite_prompts.text_keep: Rewrite the following line so that it keeps exactly the same tone and emotional state but changes every specific detail (names, objects, places, numbers): "{ar}". Reply with only the rewritten line.

config.gen_seed_rule: crc32('seed|emotion|alpha|rep|arm|part') & 0x7fffffff, + batch start index; `arm` is EMPTY for part 'B' so all six arms sample B's reply with common random numbers, and kept for parts 'readout', 'readout_B' and 'rewrite'
config.rand_dir_seed_rule: crc32('rand|seed|EMOTIONS.index(e)|rep') & 0x7fffffff; one fresh norm-matched direction per (emotion, rep) AND per ablated layer

control_pointers.per_layer_gate: b1c_alllayer.py main (L1149-L1198): acl_core.split_half at EVERY ablated hidden_states index (13..n_layers-1) plus the focus layer, n_per_half=min(N//2,600), 10 seeds; the run EXITS without generating anything if any ablated layer's class mean is below 0.8 (PREREG §3 'the run proceeds only if')
control_pointers.all_layer_ablation: b1c_alllayer.py main (L1108-L1119) and ::dirs_for (L1273-L1287): ONE acl_core.Ablate over decoder blocks 12..n_layers-2 (hs 13..n_layers-1); the per-arm `dirs` dict holds only that arm's layers and Ablate._mk leaves a hidden state untouched when `dirs.get(hs_index)` is None, so emo13_42 and emo_all/rand_all share one hook set
control_pointers.random_control: b1c_alllayer.py::rand_dirs_for (L1214-L1228) -> acl_core.random_dir_like, a FRESH draw per (emotion, rep) AND per ablated layer, seeded by ::rand_dir_seed (L221-L228); the seed is in every row as rand_dir_seed and the norm actually removed as removed_norm (read it with mask_n_positions and n_layers_ablated)
control_pointers.text_exclusion: b1c_alllayer.py::rewrite_A (L1385-L1443): a rewrite whose acl_core.degeneracy refusal flag is set, or that has fewer than 3 words, or that is identical to the original, DROPS that scenario from the arm-row (the `scenario` id list shrinks with it) and is counted in text_excluded_n / text_excluded_frac
control_pointers.text_keep_control: b1c_alllayer.py REWRITE_KEEP_PROMPT + ::rewrite_A (L1385-L1443): the same pipeline and the same exclusion rules with the affect-PRESERVING instruction, so `text` minus `text_keep` separates 'affect removed' from 'context changed'
control_pointers.blocked_paired_contrast: acl_core.paired_slope_contrast(block=..., pair_doses=True) -> acl_core._blocked_paired_slope_contrast, called from b1c_alllayer.py::analyze (L408-L564) on the balanced scenario panel built by ::panel (L275-L305); one-sample bootstrap over scenarios of the per-scenario paired slope difference, 5000 draws, seed 0
control_pointers.decision_rule: b1c_alllayer.py::_decide (L647-L686), called from ::analyze (L408-L564); the median blocked fraction of emo_all_vs_rand_all over testable emotions with a bootstrap CI over scenarios, thresholds 0.5/0.65/0.8/0.6 fixed in this file's module docstring and in PREREG_B1c §5 before the run; ::blocked_fraction (L326-L346) is sign-aware
control_pointers.secondary_outcome: b1c_alllayer.py::readout (L1334-L1383) with who='B' and the reply appended to the conversation, hooks OFF — stored per row as B_readout_e
control_pointers.reproducible_sampling: b1c_alllayer.py::gen_seed (L207-L218), called immediately before every h.model.generate in ::gen_B (L1289-L1332), ::rewrite_A (L1385-L1443) and before the readout forward in ::readout (L1334-L1383)
control_pointers.non_circular_measurement: b1c_alllayer.py main (L1127-L1145): probe fitted on the READ half, steering and ablation directions on the disjoint DIR half
control_pointers.frozen_token_audit: arms none/emo13_42/emo_all/rand_all regenerate B under the intervention while A's message predates it; arms text/text_keep regenerate A's message too. See out['frozen_token_audit'].
